# Background

Cremers, Lauterbach and Pajuste (2022) find that the valuation premium of dual-class firms
disappears within six to nine years of the IPO. Kim and Michaely (2019) reach the same conclusion
using operating performance rather than Tobin's q.

In 2021, 31 percent of technology IPOs carried a dual-class structure (Ritter, IPO Statistics,
Table 23). In our sample of 412 dual-class firms, the median discount relative to matched
single-class peers is 11 percent (Table 4, column 3).
